test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_lc (x UInt64, lc LowCardinality(Nullable(String))) ENGINE = MergeTree order by x
CREATE TABLE test_lc_agg (x UInt64, lc LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree order by x
CREATE TABLE test_lc_shared (x UInt64, lc LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree order by x
CREATE TABLE test_lc_runs (x UInt64, lc LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree order by x
CREATE TABLE test_lc_hc (x UInt64, lc LowCardinality(String), u UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree order by x
CREATE TABLE test_lc_long (x UInt64, lc LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree order by x
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_lc SELECT number, number % 10 ? NULL : toString(number % 10000) FROM numbers(1e7)
INSERT INTO test_lc_agg SELECT number, concat('model ', toString(number * 7919 % 166)) FROM numbers(1e8)
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_lc_agg FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
INSERT INTO test_lc_shared SELECT number, concat('value ', toString(cityHash64(number) % 8001)) FROM numbers(1e8)
INSERT INTO test_lc_runs SELECT number, concat('model ', toString(intDiv(number, 50000) % 166)) FROM numbers(1e8)
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_lc_runs FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
INSERT INTO test_lc_hc SELECT number, concat(if(cityHash64(number, 1) % 2 = 0, 'X', 'Y'), toString(cityHash64(number, 2) % 500000)), cityHash64(number, 3) % 1000000000 FROM numbers(1e7)
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_lc_hc FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
INSERT INTO test_lc_long SELECT number, concat(toString(cityHash64(number) % 8000), repeat('x', 1020)) FROM numbers(2e6)
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_lc_long FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
